npot: count of potion slots with id >= 2 (0 INVALID = unwritten slot, 1 EMPTY_POTION_SLOT)
gold: player.gold decoded from glob[:, 74] (float16 slog, rounding about +-0.2 %)
room: from elite_boss code (0 MONSTER, 1 ELITE incl. MONSTER_ELITE, 2 BOSS, 3 OTHER); the raw room string is not in the tensor
